create_hashblock: create a HashBlock instance with config dict containing use_hash, hash_size, hash_level, start_scale, use_color_hash, remove_conflict, and color_hash_size keys
get_occupancy: check if 3D coordinates are already occupied in the multi-scale hash map using getOccupy
set_occupancy: mark 3D coordinates as occupied in the multi-scale hash map using setOccupy
detect_hash_conflicts: find hash collision indices among 3D coordinates using get_no_conflict_index to filter conflicting entries
save_hash_table: save the current hash maps and configuration to a numpy .npz file using save_hash_table
